summary: VEON MidCo B.V. upsize its tender offer for up to $1.014B of its 3.375% Notes due 2027 to a Maximum Aggregate Purchase Price of $875M (from $750M). The offer is for cash at $987.50/$1,000 principal (Early) or $957.50 (general). The tender is subject to a New Financing Condition, guaranteed by VEON Amsterdam B.V. Accrued interest is paid separately. The filing is a Form 6-K (Foreign Private Issuer) reporting the upsize. Watch for satisfaction of the financing condition and final acceptance; risk-arb angle is minimal as this is a debt tender for liability management, not equity.
